main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). An undulating 1,600m country oval located in the Hunter / North West region of NSW. Features tight turns and subtle back-stretch rises, but finishes with a spacious, fair 400m home straight.
main_turf.post_bias: In 1000m and 1100m sprint dashes, inside barriers (stalls 1–4) hold a distinct advantage into the quick first turn. In 1450m and 1600m routes, the 400m straight allows wider runners time to settle into cover.

handicapping_angles.tamworth_and_scone_shippers: Quirindi regularly attracts strong stables from Tamworth, Scone, and Newcastle (e.g. Cody Morgan, Stephen Jones, Kris Lees). Upgrade shippers coming off Tamworth or Scone Showcase maidens and BM58s (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.undulating_rhythm_and_400m_stretch: Horses must handle undulations into the home turn. Once straight, the 400m home straight gives balanced stalkers ('P') and closers ('S') a fair run to catch tired leaders.
handicapping_angles.quirindi_cup_showcase: During the Quirindi Cup Showcase carnival in February, race quality elevates to Provincial level. Factor in higher par offsets for Cup day feature races.
